decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API has been shown on its own page for two years. It costs little to keep online because it runs on the firm's existing messaging infrastructure. Since nothing indicates its value will fail to materialize, the option is worth keeping open.

Launched only in 2024, the email-to-SMS gateway's prospects are still uncertain. It is a low-cost add-on to the core SMS platform, so keeping it open is cheaper than abandoning it before results reveal its value.
The SMS-to-email gateway is a new 2024 option that complements Products A and B on shared infrastructure. Its maintenance cost is minimal and too little evidence exists yet to justify dropping it.
